name: Echo Tower
storyline:
Our story takes place on a planet. So far away, no stars illuminate it. The only light that allows the people to thrive comes from the top of a tall, mysterious tower.

One day, the flickering light caused everyone to panic. The villagers gathered in front of the tower, but none could enter...

Echo, the grandson of the village chief, wasn't the bravest. But one day, as his curiosity led him to explore beyond the illuminated area, he stumbled upon BeepBop a weird talking and shiny rock who had a connection to the tower and knew how to enter inside.

Our heroes then decided to save the village by entering the tower and reaching the top...
summary:
Climb a tower plunged into darkness using the power of echo location.

Echo Tower is an audio action adventure game where your ears replace your eyes. Navigate through the floors, solve puzzles and reach the top to bring back the light to the planet.
